items.headline: Kuwait Confirms Successful Defense of Its Airspace Following US Military Operations in Region
items.teaser: Kuwait's military has announced that it intercepted aerial targets, amid heightened tensions in the region following US military strikes …
items.story:
Kuwait's military has announced that it intercepted aerial targets, amid heightened tensions in the region following US military strikes on multiple targets in Iran. The incident occurred after President Donald Trump vowed to continue attacks on Iran, despite earlier suggestions that a deal to end the conflict was nearing. The US strikes have raised concerns about a potential escalation of violence in the Middle East. According to reports, Kuwait's air defense systems were activated to counter the perceived threat, although no further details have been provided.

The latest developments are part of an ongoing cycle of violence between the US and Iran, which has been simmering for months. The conflict has its roots in the US withdrawal from the Iran nuclear deal and the subsequent reimposition of economic sanctions on Tehran. The situation has been further complicated by recent incidents, including the downing of a US drone and attacks on oil tankers in the Gulf. As the situation continues to unfold, there are growing concerns about the potential for a wider conflict, which could have far-reaching consequences for the region and the global economy.

US military officials have confirmed that multiple targets were struck in Iran, although the exact nature and extent of the damage are not yet clear. President Trump has stated that the strikes were carried out in response to Iranian aggression, and that further action will be taken if necessary. Iranian officials have vowed to retaliate against the US and its allies, raising the stakes in an already volatile situation. The international community is watching the developments with concern, as the potential for a wider conflict continues to grow.

The US strikes on Iran have been met with a mixture of reactions from stakeholders and markets. Oil prices have risen sharply, reflecting concerns about the potential disruption to global energy supplies. The US stock market has also been affected, with investors seeking safe-haven assets amid the uncertainty. In the region, countries such as Kuwait and Saudi Arabia are on high alert, with military personnel and equipment being mobilized to counter any potential threats. The United Nations has called for restraint and diplomacy, urging all parties to avoid further escalation.

The current situation has significant implications for the wider region and the global community. The conflict between the US and Iran has the potential to draw in other countries, including Saudi Arabia, Israel, and Iraq. The situation is also being closely watched by other major powers, including China and Russia, which have significant economic and strategic interests in the region. As the situation continues to unfold, there are concerns about the potential for a wider conflict, which could have far-reaching consequences for global security and stability.

As the situation continues to develop, all eyes will be on the next moves by the US and Iran. President Trump has stated that he is willing to negotiate with Iranian leaders, but only if they agree to certain conditions. Iranian officials have rejected these demands, and have instead called for the US to lift its economic sanctions. The international community will be watching closely to see if a diplomatic solution can be found, or if the conflict will continue to escalate. In the meantime, countries in the region will remain on high alert, as the potential for further violence remains a significant concern.

items.headline: US Entertainment Industry Weighs AI's Impact, While Global Filmmakers Explore Its Creative Potential
items.teaser: Indian filmmakers are increasingly experimenting with artificial intelligence in their productions, a trend that contrasts with the more …
items.story:
Indian filmmakers are increasingly experimenting with artificial intelligence in their productions, a trend that contrasts with the more cautious approach seen in Hollywood, where debates about the role of AI in filmmaking continue to unfold. This development is significant because India's film industry, also known as Bollywood, is one of the largest in the world, producing over a thousand films a year. As a result, the country's embracing of AI in filmmaking could have far-reaching implications for the global entertainment industry. The use of AI in Indian films is not limited to special effects, but also extends to other areas such as scriptwriting and editing.

The use of artificial intelligence in filmmaking is not new, but it has gained momentum in recent years with advancements in technology and the increasing availability of AI tools. In the past, AI was primarily used in Hollywood blockbusters for tasks such as visual effects and animation, but its application has now expanded to other areas of filmmaking. The Indian film industry, which has a long history of experimenting with new technologies, has been quick to adopt AI in various aspects of film production. This has been driven in part by the need to reduce production costs and increase efficiency, as well as to create new and innovative storytelling experiences.

According to industry experts, the use of AI in Indian films has resulted in significant cost savings and improved productivity. For example, AI-powered tools can be used to automate tasks such as color correction and sound design, freeing up human resources for more creative work. Additionally, AI can be used to analyze audience data and provide insights on what types of films are likely to be successful, allowing filmmakers to make more informed decisions. Official statements from Indian film industry associations have also highlighted the potential of AI to create new job opportunities in areas such as AI development and training.

The reaction to the use of AI in Indian films has been largely positive, with many filmmakers and industry professionals seeing it as a way to enhance the storytelling experience and increase productivity. However, there are also concerns about the potential impact of AI on jobs in the film industry, particularly in areas such as editing and visual effects. Some stakeholders have also raised questions about the creative potential of AI, and whether it can truly replace human imagination and creativity. Despite these concerns, the use of AI in Indian films is likely to continue, driven by the need for innovation and efficiency in a highly competitive industry.

The use of AI in Indian films is part of a broader trend of technological innovation in the country's entertainment industry. India has a thriving tech sector, and many startups are working on developing AI-powered solutions for the film industry. This has created new opportunities for collaboration and innovation, with filmmakers and technologists working together to create new and innovative storytelling experiences. The global implications of this trend are significant, as it could potentially disrupt traditional models of film production and distribution, and create new opportunities for filmmakers and audiences around the world.

As the use of AI in Indian films continues to evolve, it will be important to watch how the industry addresses the challenges and opportunities presented by this technology. Upcoming decisions on issues such as copyright and intellectual property, as well as the development of new regulations and standards for the use of AI in filmmaking, will be critical in shaping the future of the industry. Additionally, the response of audiences to AI-powered films will be an important factor in determining the long-term success of this trend, and whether it will become a permanent feature of the Indian film industry.

items.headline: Global oil prices surge amid escalating US-Iran tensions and heightened concerns over supply chain stability.
items.teaser: Oil prices surged on Thursday as the United States launched a fresh round of military strikes against targets in Iran, sparking concerns …
items.story:
Oil prices surged on Thursday as the United States launched a fresh round of military strikes against targets in Iran, sparking concerns about potential disruptions to global energy flows. The strikes, which were carried out by US forces, targeted various facilities and infrastructure in Iran, according to official reports. This development has significant implications for the global energy market, as Iran is a major oil producer and any disruption to its production could have far-reaching consequences. The price of Brent crude oil jumped by over 2% in the aftermath of the strikes, reflecting the market's anxiety about the situation.

The current tensions between the US and Iran have been escalating for some time, with both countries engaging in a series of diplomatic and military exchanges. The conflict has its roots in a longstanding dispute over Iran's nuclear program, as well as its regional influence and military activities. The US has been seeking to curb Iran's nuclear ambitions and limit its ability to project power in the region, while Iran has been resisting these efforts and seeking to maintain its independence and sovereignty. This complex and volatile situation has created an atmosphere of uncertainty and instability in the region, which is now being reflected in the global energy market.

According to official reports, the US strikes targeted various Iranian military and industrial facilities, including those involved in the production and development of ballistic missiles. The strikes were carried out in response to recent Iranian attacks on US interests in the region, including a drone strike on a major Saudi oil facility. US officials have stated that the strikes were intended to deter further Iranian aggression and to demonstrate the country's commitment to defending its interests and allies in the region. Iranian officials, on the other hand, have vowed to retaliate against the US and its allies, setting the stage for a potentially escalating conflict.

The reaction to the US strikes has been swift and decisive, with oil prices surging and global financial markets experiencing increased volatility. The price of Brent crude oil has risen to its highest level in several months, reflecting the market's concern about the potential disruption to global energy flows. Analysts and experts are warning that the conflict could have significant and far-reaching consequences for the global economy, including higher energy prices, reduced economic growth, and increased instability in the Middle East. The international community is watching the situation closely, with many countries calling for restraint and diplomacy to resolve the conflict peacefully.

The current situation has significant implications for the global energy market and the regional security landscape. The Middle East is a critical region for global energy production and distribution, with many major oil-producing countries located there. Any disruption to energy flows from the region could have significant consequences for the global economy, including higher energy prices, reduced economic growth, and increased instability. The conflict between the US and Iran is also having a ripple effect on other countries in the region, with many seeking to avoid being drawn into the conflict. The international community is urging restraint and diplomacy to resolve the conflict peacefully and to prevent a wider regional war.

As the situation continues to unfold, many questions remain about the potential consequences and outcomes of the conflict. The US and Iran are engaged in a high-stakes game of diplomatic and military brinksmanship, with neither side showing any signs of backing down. The international community is watching the situation closely, with many countries seeking to avoid being drawn into the conflict. The price of oil is likely to remain volatile in the coming days and weeks, reflecting the market's uncertainty and anxiety about the situation. As the conflict continues to evolve, it is likely that there will be significant developments and new challenges emerging, making it essential to monitor the situation closely and to be prepared for any eventuality.

items.headline: Software giant exceeds profit forecasts, but shares decline on massive capital injection plan.
items.teaser: Oracle Corporation reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, but its stock price dropped significantly after the company announce…
items.story:
Oracle Corporation reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, but its stock price dropped significantly after the company announced plans to raise an additional $20 billion in capital, primarily to fund its ambitious data center expansion projects. The company's latest financial results were released, showing a strong performance in its cloud computing segment. Oracle's revenue and profit exceeded analyst expectations, driven by increased demand for its cloud-based services. The company's management expressed confidence in its long-term growth strategy, despite the current challenges.

The recent development is significant, given Oracle's history of investing heavily in its data center infrastructure to support its growing cloud business. The company has been expanding its presence in the global cloud market, competing with major players such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Oracle's data center projects are crucial to its strategy, as they enable the company to offer a wide range of cloud services, including infrastructure, platform, and software as a service. The company's investments in data centers have been substantial, and the planned $20 billion capital raise is expected to further support this effort.

According to the company's financial statements, Oracle's free cash flow was negative, which may have contributed to the decision to raise additional capital. The company's management stated that the capital raise is necessary to support its growth plans, including the expansion of its data center footprint. Oracle's CEO emphasized the importance of investing in the company's cloud infrastructure, citing the strong demand for its cloud services. The company reported a significant increase in its cloud revenue, which now accounts for a substantial portion of its total revenue.

The market reaction to Oracle's announcement was negative, with the company's stock price dropping sharply after the news. Investors were apparently concerned about the company's decision to raise additional debt, given its already significant capital expenditures. Analysts noted that the capital raise may be necessary to support Oracle's growth ambitions, but it also increases the company's financial leverage. The reaction from stakeholders was mixed, with some expressing confidence in the company's long-term strategy, while others raised concerns about the potential risks associated with the increased debt.

The development has implications for the broader technology industry, particularly in the cloud computing sector. Oracle's expansion plans are likely to increase competition in the market, which may lead to further investments by other cloud providers. The company's decision to raise additional capital may also be seen as a sign of the increasing costs associated with building and maintaining large-scale data center infrastructure. The trend is expected to continue, with cloud providers investing heavily in their infrastructure to support the growing demand for cloud services.

As Oracle moves forward with its plans, the company will need to balance its growth ambitions with the potential risks associated with increased debt. The company's management will need to demonstrate its ability to execute on its strategy, while also managing the financial implications of its investments. Investors and analysts will be closely watching the company's progress, particularly in terms of its ability to generate positive free cash flow and reduce its financial leverage. The outcome will be crucial for Oracle's long-term success, as the company competes in the highly competitive cloud computing market.

items.headline: Multinational shifts operations to Malaysia, capitalizing on lower costs and expanded workspace.
items.teaser: A growing number of companies are relocating from Singapore to Malaysia, driven by the promise of lower costs, tax incentives, and access…
items.story:
A growing number of companies are relocating from Singapore to Malaysia, driven by the promise of lower costs, tax incentives, and access to a larger market, with the latest example being a major firm that has announced its decision to shift its operations to the Malaysian city of Kuala Lumpur. This move is part of a rising global mobility trend, where businesses are increasingly seeking to optimize their operations and reduce expenses by relocating to more affordable destinations. The company, which has not been named, is expected to complete its relocation by the end of the year, with hundreds of jobs set to be transferred to Malaysia. The shift is seen as a significant vote of confidence in Malaysia's business-friendly environment and its ability to attract foreign investment.

The relocation of companies from Singapore to Malaysia is not a new phenomenon, but it has gained momentum in recent years, driven by a combination of factors, including rising costs in Singapore and aggressive efforts by the Malaysian government to attract foreign investment. Singapore, one of the most expensive cities in the world, has seen a significant increase in operating costs, including rent, labor, and utilities, making it less competitive for businesses. In contrast, Malaysia offers a more affordable alternative, with lower costs and a range of incentives, including tax breaks and investment grants, designed to attract foreign companies. This shift is also seen as part of a broader trend, where companies are increasingly looking to relocate to destinations that offer a more favorable business environment.

According to official data, the number of companies relocating from Singapore to Malaysia has increased significantly over the past few years, with many citing the lower costs and more favorable business environment as the main reasons for their decision. The Malaysian government has also reported a significant increase in foreign investment, with many companies taking advantage of the country's business-friendly policies and incentives. Experts say that the relocation of companies from Singapore to Malaysia is a win-win situation for both countries, with Singapore benefiting from the opportunity to focus on higher-value activities, while Malaysia gains from the influx of foreign investment and expertise. The Malaysian government has also announced plans to invest in infrastructure and human capital, in order to support the growth of foreign investment and to attract more companies to the country.

The relocation of companies from Singapore to Malaysia has been welcomed by stakeholders, including business leaders and government officials, who see it as a positive development for the region. The move is expected to create new job opportunities and stimulate economic growth in Malaysia, while also providing companies with a more affordable and competitive alternative to Singapore. However, some have also raised concerns about the potential impact on Singapore's economy, including the loss of jobs and revenue. Nevertheless, experts say that the relocation of companies from Singapore to Malaysia is a natural process, driven by the changing needs of businesses and the evolving economic landscape of the region.

The trend of companies relocating from Singapore to Malaysia is part of a broader shift in the regional economy, driven by the growing importance of Southeast Asia as a hub for trade and investment. The region is home to some of the fastest-growing economies in the world, including Indonesia, Vietnam, and the Philippines, and is seen as a key destination for foreign investment. The relocation of companies from Singapore to Malaysia is also driven by the need for businesses to be closer to their customers and to take advantage of the region's growing consumer market. As the regional economy continues to grow and evolve, it is likely that more companies will follow suit, seeking to optimize their operations and reduce costs by relocating to more affordable destinations.

As the trend of companies relocating from Singapore to Malaysia continues to gain momentum, it remains to be seen how the two countries will respond to the changing needs of businesses and the evolving economic landscape of the region. The Malaysian government is expected to continue to invest in infrastructure and human capital, in order to support the growth of foreign investment and to attract more companies to the country. Meanwhile, the Singaporean government is likely to focus on developing new industries and sectors, including technology and innovation, in order to remain competitive and attractive to businesses. As the region continues to grow and evolve, it is likely that the trend of companies relocating from Singapore to Malaysia will continue, driven by the changing needs of businesses and the pursuit of competitiveness and profitability.

The launch of the Agents' Last Exam benchmark is part of a broader trend in AI research, which is focused on developing more comprehensive and rigorous evaluations of AI capabilities. The development of benchmarks like the Agents' Last Exam is a significant step forward in this direction, as it provides a more nuanced understanding of AI capabilities and identifies areas for improvement. The company's decision to go public reflects its ambition to expand its operations, invest in new technologies, and pursue new opportunities for growth and development. The global space industry is expected to continue growing, driven by government initiatives, private investment, and the increasing importance of space-based technologies.

As the SpaceX IPO approaches, investors and industry observers will be watching closely for signs of market trends and investor sentiment. items.headline: US inflation surges at three-year high, prompting President's upbeat economic assessment.
items.teaser: President Donald Trump stated that he "loves the inflation" as the United States experiences its fastest rate of price increases in three…
items.story:
President Donald Trump stated that he "loves the inflation" as the United States experiences its fastest rate of price increases in three years, amid growing concerns over the economic impact of the US-Israel war in Iran. The comments have sparked widespread debate, with many economists and experts warning of the potential consequences of rising inflation on consumer spending and economic growth. The US inflation rate has been steadily increasing over the past year, driven in part by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. As a result, consumers are feeling the strain of higher prices, particularly for essential goods such as food and fuel.

The current inflation surge is largely attributed to the disruption of global supply chains and the subsequent increase in production costs, which have been exacerbated by the US-Israel war in Iran. Historically, periods of high inflation have been associated with decreased consumer spending and economic growth, as households are forced to allocate a larger portion of their income towards essential expenses. The US has experienced several periods of high inflation in the past, including the 1970s and early 1980s, which were characterized by stagnant economic growth and decreased consumer spending. The Federal Reserve has been closely monitoring the situation, adjusting interest rates to mitigate the effects of inflation and maintain economic stability.

According to recent data, the US inflation rate has risen to its highest level in three years, with prices increasing by over 3% in the past year. The consumer price index, which measures the average change in prices of a basket of goods and services, has shown a steady increase over the past year, driven primarily by rising food and fuel costs. Official statements from the White House have emphasized the administration's commitment to maintaining economic growth and stability, despite the challenges posed by the current inflationary environment. Experts warn that if left unchecked, high inflation could have far-reaching consequences for the US economy, including decreased consumer spending and reduced economic growth.

The rising inflation rate has significant implications for US consumers, who are already feeling the strain of higher prices for essential goods and services. Many households have been forced to adjust their budgets, allocating a larger portion of their income towards essential expenses such as food, fuel, and housing. The impact of inflation is being felt across various sectors, including retail and manufacturing, where businesses are struggling to maintain profit margins in the face of rising production costs. As the US economy continues to navigate the challenges posed by the current inflationary environment, stakeholders are closely watching the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions, which will play a crucial role in shaping the country's economic trajectory.

The US-Israel war in Iran has significant regional and global implications, with many countries closely monitoring the situation and its potential impact on global trade and economic stability. The conflict has already led to a significant increase in oil prices, which has had a ripple effect on the global economy, contributing to rising inflation rates in several countries. As the situation continues to unfold, experts warn of the potential for further economic disruption, particularly if the conflict escalates or spreads to other regions. The international community is urging a peaceful resolution to the conflict, recognizing the potential consequences of prolonged instability in the region.

As the US economy continues to navigate the challenges posed by the current inflationary environment, policymakers and stakeholders are closely watching the Federal Reserve's next moves, which will play a crucial role in shaping the country's economic trajectory. The Fed is expected to make key decisions on interest rates and monetary policy in the coming months, which will have significant implications for the US economy and the global financial landscape. With the US presidential election on the horizon, the state of the economy is likely to be a major campaign issue, with candidates vying for office pledging to address the challenges posed by rising inflation and maintain economic growth and stability.

items.headline: Sri Lanka's Central Bank Streamlines Exporter Dollar Conversion Process to a 30-Day Timeline
items.teaser: Sri Lanka's Central Bank has reduced the time allowed for exporters to convert their dollars to 30 days, a move aimed at conserving the c…
items.story:
Sri Lanka's Central Bank has reduced the time allowed for exporters to convert their dollars to 30 days, a move aimed at conserving the country's dwindling foreign exchange reserves. The decision, which came into effect recently, is expected to have a significant impact on the country's economy, which has been struggling with a severe dollar shortage. The Central Bank's move is seen as an effort to stem the outflow of foreign currency and stabilize the local currency, the rupee. This development is crucial for Sri Lanka, which is facing its worst economic crisis in decades.

The reduction in the dollar conversion time is a significant shift from the previous limit of 120 days, which was in place for several years. The move is part of a broader effort by the Central Bank to manage the country's foreign exchange reserves, which have been depleted due to a combination of factors, including a decline in tourism and remittances. Sri Lanka's economy has been struggling to recover from the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the country has been facing a severe shortage of dollars, which has led to a sharp depreciation of the rupee. The Central Bank's decision is seen as a necessary measure to conserve the country's foreign exchange reserves and stabilize the economy.

According to official statements, the new rule requires exporters to convert their dollars within 30 days of earning them, failing which they will have to pay a penalty. The Central Bank has also warned that exporters who fail to comply with the new rule will face penalties, including fines and even cancellation of their export licenses. The move is expected to affect a wide range of exporters, including those in the textile, tea, and rubber industries, which are among the country's top foreign exchange earners. The decision is seen as a key step towards stabilizing the country's foreign exchange market and promoting economic growth.

The reaction to the Central Bank's decision has been mixed, with some exporters welcoming the move as a necessary step to stabilize the economy, while others have expressed concerns about the potential impact on their businesses. Some exporters have warned that the new rule could lead to a shortage of dollars in the market, which could further exacerbate the country's economic crisis. The decision is also expected to have an impact on the country's trade balance, with some exporters warning that the new rule could lead to a decline in exports. The government has, however, assured that the move is necessary to conserve the country's foreign exchange reserves and stabilize the economy.

The Central Bank's decision is part of a broader effort by the government to stabilize the economy and promote economic growth. The government has been working to implement a range of reforms, including measures to promote foreign investment, increase exports, and reduce the country's trade deficit. The decision to reduce the dollar conversion time is seen as a key step towards achieving these goals, and is expected to have a positive impact on the country's economy in the long term. The move is also expected to have regional implications, with other countries in the region watching closely to see the impact of the decision on Sri Lanka's economy.

The impact of the Central Bank's decision will be closely watched in the coming weeks and months, as the country's economy continues to struggle with a range of challenges. The government is expected to take further measures to stabilize the economy and promote economic growth, including the implementation of a range of reforms and the negotiation of a bailout package with the International Monetary Fund. The decision to reduce the dollar conversion time is seen as a key step towards achieving these goals, and is expected to have a significant impact on the country's economy in the long term. items.story: ഷിഗെല്ല: വയനാട്ടിൽ 3 പഞ്ചായത്തിലും ഒരു മുനിസിപ്പാലിറ്റിയിലും വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾക്ക് 14 വരെ അവധി പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു Manorama Onlineഷിഗെല്ല: നെന്മേനി പഞ്ചായത്തിൽ ആൾക്കൂട്ട നിയന്ത്രണം Mathrubhumiഷിഗല്ല: വയനാട് ജില്ലയിലെ നാല് തദ്ദേശസ്ഥാപനങ്ങളിലെ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾക്ക് നാല് ദിവസം അവധി Asianet News Malayalamഅഞ്ച് വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികള്‍ക്ക് കൂടി ഷിഗെല്ല; ബത്തേരിയില്‍ ജാഗ്രത manoramanews.comവയനാട്ടിൽ അഞ്ച് പേർക്ക് കൂടി ഷിഗെല്ല; ജില്ലയിൽ രോഗബാധിതരായ വിദ്യാർഥികളുടെ എണ്ണം എട്ടായി Media One

items.story: കോഴിക്കോട് വീണ്ടും നിപ്പ; രോഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത് 43കാരന് Manorama Onlineകോഴിക്കോട്ട് വീണ്ടും നിപ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ചികിത്സയിലുള്ളത് 43കാരൻ News18 Malayalamകോഴിക്കോട്ട് വീണ്ടും നിപ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു manoramanews.comകോഴിക്കോട്ട് നിപ വൈറസ് ബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ചികിത്സയിലുള്ളത് ഫറോക്ക് സ്വദേശിയായ 43-കാരൻ Mathrubhumiകോഴിക്കോട് നിപ രോഗലക്ഷണങ്ങളോടെ ഒരാള്‍ ചികിത്സയില്‍ Siraj Daily

items.story: Kerala News today highlights: നവകേരള യാത്രയിലെ 'രക്ഷാപ്രവർത്തനം'; മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യത്തിനെതിരെ ഹൈക്കോടതിയിൽ അപ്പീൽ നൽകും Indian Express - Malayalam‘പ്രതികൾ പരാതിക്കാരെ സ്വാധീനിക്കില്ല, ചോദ്യം ചെയ്യലിന് ഹാജരാകണം’: ‘രക്ഷാപ്രവർത്തകർക്ക്’ മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യം Manorama Online'രക്ഷാപ്രവർത്തകർക്ക്' ആശ്വാസം; പിണറായി വിജയന്റെ ഗൺമാന്മാർക്ക് മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യം Mathrubhumiനവകേരള യാത്രക്കിടയിലെ ആലപ്പുഴയിലെ ‘രക്ഷാപ്രവർത്തനം’; ഗൺമാൻ ഉള്‍പ്പെടെ 5 പ്രതികൾക്കും മുൻകൂർ ജാമ്യം News18 Malayalamവിധിയില്‍ നിരാശ, ഒന്നും അവസാനമല്ല; നിയമപ

items.story: ഒമാൻ തീരത്ത് കപ്പലിന് നേരെ യുഎസ് മിസൈലാക്രമണം: രണ്ട് ഇന്ത്യൻ നാവികരെ കാണാതായി Manorama Onlineരക്ഷിക്കണേ; കപ്പല്‍ മുങ്ങുന്നു'; കരഞ്ഞ് വിളിച്ച് ഇന്ത്യന്‍ നാവികര്‍; വില്ലനായി അമേരിക്ക manoramanews.comഹോർമുസിന് സമീപം കപ്പൽ ആക്രമണം; കുടുങ്ങിയ 24 ഇന്ത്യൻ നാവികരെ സുരക്ഷിതമായി ഒഴിപ്പിച്ചു Mathrubhumiഹോർമുസിന് സമീപം ഒമാൻ തീരത്ത് ഓയിൽ ടാങ്കറിന് ആക്രമണത്തിൽ തീപിടിച്ചു; 24 ഇന്ത്യൻ നാവികരെയും രക്ഷപ്പെടുത്തി News18 Malayalamഒമാന്‍ തീരത്തെ കപ്പലാക്രമണം: 3 ഇന്ത്യക്കാരെ കാണാനില്ല, ആശങ്കയറിയിച്ച് കേന്ദ്രം Samakal

items.story: കേന്ദ്ര വിദ‍്യാഭ‍്യാസ മന്ത്രി രാജി വയ്ക്കും വരെ പിന്മാറില്ല; രാജ‍്യ വ‍്യാപക പ്രതിഷേധത്തിനൊരുങ്ങി പാറ്റകൾ Metro Vaartha‘ധർമേന്ദ്ര പ്രധാൻ രാജിവെക്കുംവരെ സമരം’; വിവിധ നഗരങ്ങളിലേക്ക് പ്രതിഷേധം വ്യാപിപ്പിക്കാൻ സിജെപി Mathrubhumi‘ഇന്ത്യൻ രാഷ്ട്രീയം ഹിന്ദു-മുസ്‌ലിം അജണ്ടയെ കേന്ദ്രീകരിച്ച്; നേപ്പാളിലെയും ബംഗ്ലദേശിലെയും പ്രക്ഷോഭങ്ങളുമായി താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യരുത്’ Manorama Online`സർക്കാരിനെ ഭയന്ന് എത്രകാലം ജീവിക്കും?' ധർമ്മേന്ദ്രപ്രദാൻ രാജിവെക്കും വരെ പ്രതിഷേധം തുടരുമെന്ന് അഭിജിത് ദീപ്കേ Asianet News Malayalam

items.headline: ‘ഇതല്ലേ മാഷേ നേരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞത്...’; തിരുത്താൻ നേതൃത്വം ഇനിയെങ്കിലും തയാറാകുമോയെന്നും വി. കുഞ്ഞികൃഷ്ണൻ...
items.teaser: ‘ഇതല്ലേ മാഷേ നേരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞത്...’; തിരുത്താൻ നേതൃത്വം ഇനിയെങ്കിലും തയാറാകുമോയെന്നും വി. കുഞ്ഞികൃഷ്ണൻ... Madhyamam'അഭിപ്രായം പറയാന്‍ പോലും …
items.story: ‘ഇതല്ലേ മാഷേ നേരത്തെ പറഞ്ഞത്...’; തിരുത്താൻ നേതൃത്വം ഇനിയെങ്കിലും തയാറാകുമോയെന്നും വി. കുഞ്ഞികൃഷ്ണൻ... Madhyamam'അഭിപ്രായം പറയാന്‍ പോലും പ്രവര്‍ത്തകര്‍ക്ക് ഭയം, സിപിഎമ്മില്‍ കൂടുതലും 'യെസ്മാന്‍മാര്‍'; ഫാസിസത്തിന്റെ അടയാളം' Samakalika Malayalamനേതൃത്വം കൂടുതൽ തെറ്റുകളിലേക്കാണ് പോകുന്നത് -സി.വി.ബാലകൃഷ്ണൻ Mathrubhumi75 വയസ്സ് കഴിഞ്ഞവര്‍ സംഘടനാ പ്രവര്‍ത്തനത്തില്‍ വേണ്ടെന്ന് സിപിഎം; പിന്നെങ്ങനെ അത്തരക്കാര്‍ സര്‍ക്കാരിനെ നയിക്കും? Samakalika Malayalamതെറ്റുകള്‍ തിരുത്തിയാല്‍ സിപിഎമ്മിന് തിരിച്ചു വരാനാ

items.story: ‘കുഞ്ഞെന്ന സ്വപ്നവുമായി ഇന്ത്യയിൽ, മരിക്കുമെന്ന് ഉറപ്പായപ്പോള്‍ പരസ്പരം കെട്ടിപ്പിടിച്ചു’: ഡൽഹിയിൽ ‘ചാരമായ’ ജീവിതങ്ങൾ Manorama Onlineഡൽഹി തീപ്പിടിത്തം; ഹോട്ടലിന്റെ നിലവറയിൽ വരെ താമസക്കാർ, പൈസ കുറവായതിനാൽ വിദേശികളും മുറിയെടുക്കും Mathrubhumiഡല്‍ഹി മാളവ്യനഗറിലെ ഹോട്ടലിലെ തീപിടിത്തം: പാചകക്കാരന്‍ അറസ്റ്റില്‍ Siraj Dailyഡല്‍ഹി ഹോട്ടല്‍ തീപിടുത്തതിന് കാരണം ഹോട്ടല്‍ ജീവനക്കാരന്റെ അനാസ്ഥ?; അറസ്റ്റ്, അന്വേഷണം തുടരുന്നു Suprabhaathamഡൽഹി ഹോട്ടൽ തീപിടുത്തം: തീപിടുത്തത്തിൽ കൊല്ലപ്പെട്ട എട്ടുപേർക്ക് പിന്നാല
